Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

PROVOST’S MESSAGE

The establishment of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan by the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa is a historic act. This region has witnessed the rise and fall of famous civilizations that inspired the world with glorious culture and civilized traditions devoted to learning and scholarship due to its location at the focal point.
Students must feel connected to their community to learn. At AWKUM, we prioritize connections between students and their faculty members, advisors, coaches, student life professionals, supervisors, community partners, tutors, and peers, among many others. Students collaborate closely with expert advisors who have been trained in best advising practices. Our nationally recognized faculty of scholars, researchers, and artists guide students’ research, practice experiential and high-impact teaching, train peer tutors, and lead student travel experiences. High-quality academics coexist with a mentoring and care culture at AWKUM. The student affairs division leads and supports co-curricular activities and personnel to ensure AWKUM’s continued educational excellence. Student Affairs is dedicated to its students and understands that grades are not the only indicator of successful learning but moral, ethical, and social activities also play an important role in a successful life.
In addition to our goals, we also provide eco-friendly, comfortable student hostel accommodation in a serene setting. Our goal is to make students feel at home by using comfortable architectural designs and sustainable building materials in our hostel facilities.

Hostels

Abdul Wali Khan University is among one of the leading universities in Pakistan which provides hostel facilities to the students on large scale. Currently there are more than 1100 students, both male & female residing in university hostels and every year this number increases gradually. This is one of the reason that students from all over Pakistan join Abdul Wali Khan University, Mardan. The hostels facility has been designed and constructed to ensure a secure, comfortable and pleasant stay and to create an environment which is conducive for learning.
BOYS HOSTELS:
Boys’ hostels are reserved for male students of all disciplines. Currently AWKUM provide accommodations in two boys hostels named Boys Hostel-I and Boys Hostel-II. The total accommodation capacity currently in both boys hostel is 540 students. The admission process of Boys hostels is dealt at office of the Provost garden campus, AWKUM.
Address: Garden Campus AWKUM Toru Road Mardan
GIRLS HOSTEL:
Girls’ hostels are reserved for female students of all disciplines and the admission process of these hostels is dealt with in the office of the Provost Garden Campus AWKUM. Currently we have 4 female hostels (Palwasha House, Sobia House, Husna House and Alia House) The total accommodation capacity of all the female hostels is 600 students.
Address: Main Campus AWKUM near College Chock Mardan
FACULTY HOSTELS:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is providing hostel facilities to its faculty members also. Foreign faculty hostel situated at Garden campus is reserved for male faculty members whereas female faculty is accommodated in the faculty hostel at main campus.
